name: yandex-kit-ai-toolkit
description: AI toolkit for the Yandex KIT e-commerce platform API: typed client, MCP server and agent skills generated from the official OpenAPI spec

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/codegen && npm run typecheck -w packages/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w packages/mcp
